note: California State Parks campground in a grove of old- and second-growth redwoods by the Humboldt Redwoods visitor center on the Avenue of the Giants, 1.5 miles south of Weott; the South Fork of the Eel is a short walk, with a summer footbridge to the trails. 21 of the 50 reservable sites are tent-only and two standard sites are under 23 ft (9 at 20 ft, 25 at 16 ft); showers are coin-operated. --Claude
summary: Burlington (Humboldt Redwoods SP): open year-round, no current restriction; $35 every night checked (winter and May 2027, Saturday the same); 57 sites, 24-ft max, 21 of 50 bookable units tent-only, 27 standard sites take 24 ft; no hookups, flush toilets, pay showers, water, no dump in the park; pin within ~110 m of the RC facility point; not waterfront (river a short walk) confirmed.
flags: MAX STAY: the park page says 'Maximum allowable stay in individual campsites is 15 nights'; ReserveCalifornia caps a booking at 7 nights on May 2027 dates and 30 in winter. Not written as a field.

SITES: 21 of the 50 web-bookable units are 'Tent Only Site'; 27 standard sites take a 24-ft rig, #9 (20 ft) and #25 (16 ft) do not. The other 7 of the 57 sites are not on ReserveCalifornia (3 are hike-and-bike).
WEBSITE: keep https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=425; https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=30998 is the park's camping page if a narrower link is wanted. Phone (707) 946-2409 confirmed.
